        self.play(Create(pos_part), FadeIn(kink), Write(kink_label), run_time=1.2, rate_func=smooth)
        
        # Zone annotations

        dead_zone.move_to(axes.c2p(-2, 1.5))
        active_zone = Text("Identity\n(f(x)=x)", font_size=22, color=GREEN_B, line_spacing=0.8)
        active_zone.move_to(axes.c2p(2, 2.5))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(dead_zone), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(active_zone), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.8)
        
        # === DERIVATIVE VISUALIZATION ===
        self.play(FadeOut(dead_zone, active_zone), run_time=0.5)
        
        zero_slope = Line(axes.c2p(-3.5, 0.3), axes.c2p(-0.5, 0.3), color=RED, stroke_width=6)
        zero_text = MathTex("0", color=RED, font_size=32).next_to(zero_slope, UP, buff=0.2)

import numpy as np

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Cinematic configuration
        self.camera.background_color = "#0c0c14"
        self.camera.frame.set_height(9)  # Base height for 16:9
        
        # ============================================================
        # ACT 1: Title and Definition
        # ============================================================
        
        # Title composition with glow layers
        title_base = Text("ReLU", font_size=120, color=BLUE_E, weight=BOLD)
        title_glow = Text("ReLU", font_size=124, color=BLUE_B, opacity=0.3, weight=BOLD)
        title_glow2 = Text("ReLU", font_size=128, color=BLUE_D, opacity=0.15, weight=BOLD)
        
        subtitle = Text("Rectified Linear Unit", font_size=40, color=GRAY_B, slant=ITALIC)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title_glow2, title_glow, title_base).center()
        subtitle.next_to(title_group, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        # Dramatic entrance
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                FadeIn(title_glow2, scale=1.1),
                FadeIn(title_glow, scale=1.05),
                FadeIn(title_base),
                lag_ratio=0.1
            ),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=ease_out_elastic
        )
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.5),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Move to header position
        self.play(
            VGroup(title_group, subtitle).animate.scale(0.35).to_edge(UP, buff=0.8),
            run_time=1.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Mathematical definition with elegant typography
        formula = MathTex(r"\text{ReLU}(x) = \max(0, x)", font_size=56, color=WHITE)
        formula.next_to(VGroup(title_group, subtitle), DOWN, buff=1.2)
        
        # Animate formula character by character
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=2.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Create explanation text
        explanation = VGroup(
            Text("If input is positive → return input", font_size=32, color=GREEN_B),
            Text("If input is negative → return zero", font_size=32, color=RED_B)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.6, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        explanation.next_to(formula, DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(explanation[0].shift(LEFT), shift=RIGHT),
            FadeIn(explanation[1].shift(LEFT), shift=RIGHT),
            lag_ratio=0.4,
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Begin transition to graph - fade out text, keep formula
        self.play(
            FadeOut(explanation),
            formula.animate.scale(0.8).to_corner(UL, buff=1),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # ============================================================
        # ACT 2: The Graph Visualization
        # ============================================================
        
        # Setup sophisticated axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-5, 5, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 5, 1],
            x_length=12,
            y_length=7,
            axis_config={
                "include_tip": True,
                "tip_length": 0.2,
                "color": WHITE,
                "stroke_width": 2
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [-4, -2, 2, 4],
                "numbers_with_elongated_ticks": [0],
                "font_size": 24
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [2, 4],
                "font_size": 24
            }
        )
        
        # Center in frame considering header
        axes.center().shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        
        # Axis labels
        x_label = MathTex("x", font_size=32, color=WHITE).next_to(axes.x_axis.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        y_label = MathTex("f(x)", font_size=32, color=WHITE).next_to(axes.y_axis.get_end(), UP, buff=0.3)
        
        # Grid for depth
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=[-5, 5, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 5, 1],
            x_length=12,
            y_length=7,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": BLUE_E,
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.2
            },
            axis_config={"stroke_opacity": 0}
        ).move_to(axes.get_center())
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(grid, opacity=0.3),
            Create(axes),
            FadeIn(x_label),
            FadeIn(y_label),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Build ReLU graph with emphasis
        relu_function = axes.plot(
            lambda x: max(0, x),
            x_range=[-5, 5],
            color=BLUE_B,
            stroke_width=8
        )
        
        # Outer glow
        relu_glow_outer = axes.plot(
            lambda x: max(0, x),
            x_range=[-5, 5],
            color=BLUE_D,
            stroke_width=20,
            stroke_opacity=0.2
        )
        
        relu_glow_inner = axes.plot(
            lambda x: max(0, x),
            x_range=[-5, 5],
            color=BLUE_A,
            stroke_width=14,
            stroke_opacity=0.4
        )
        
        # Animate the drawing of the function
        self.play(
            Create(relu_glow_outer),
            Create(relu_glow_inner),
            Create(relu_function),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Highlight the origin/knee point
        origin_dot = Dot(axes.c2p(0, 0), color=YELLOW, radius=0.15)
        origin_halo = Circle(radius=0.4, color=YELLOW, stroke_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=2).move_to(axes.c2p(0, 0))
        
        knee_label = Text("Origin (0,0)", font_size=28, color=YELLOW)
        knee_label.next_to(origin_dot, UR, buff=0.5)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(origin_halo),
            GrowFromCenter(origin_dot),
            FadeIn(knee_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # ============================================================
        # ACT 3: Visual Segmentation (Active vs Inactive)
        # ============================================================
        
        # Camera zoom to focus on the hinge
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(axes.c2p(0, 2)).scale(0.8),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Negative region (inactive)
        neg_region = axes.get_area(
            relu_function,
            x_range=[-5, 0],
            color=RED_D,
            opacity=0.3
        )
        
        neg_label = Text("Inactive", font_size=36, color=RED_B, weight=BOLD)
        neg_label.move_to(axes.c2p(-2.5, 2.5))
        
        # Positive region (active)
        pos_region = axes.get_area(
            relu_function,
            x_range=[0, 4.5],
            color=GREEN_D,
            opacity=0.3
        )
        
        pos_label = Text("Active (Linear)", font_size=36, color=GREEN_B, weight=BOLD)
        pos_label.move_to(axes.c2p(2.5, 3.5))
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(neg_region),
            FadeIn(neg_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.wait(0.3)
        
        self.play(
